summary: In a decaying, once-elegant hotel, Trinity leads Neo down the thirteenth-floor hallway from the stairwell and stops outside room 1313. She confirms this is the destination, then offers Neo a final piece of advice before he meets whoever waits inside: he should be honest, because that person knows far more than Neo can imagine. Neo is so nervous he can hear his own heart pounding.

what_changes.before: Unaware of how much the person in the room knows about him.
what_changes.after: Warned that the person inside "knows more than you can possibly imagine."
what_changes.evidence: He knows more than you can possibly imagine.

event_hint.one_line: Trinity delivers Neo to room 1313 to meet the Oracle.

uncertain: The exact time of day this meeting occurs.
